s: Din harotzeh lehosip babberakot ubo v' seipim: im ratza lehosip bekol beraka mehaemtzaiyyot meen habberaka — mosip. Ketzad? Haya lo choleh — mebaqqesh alayv rachamim be"birkat repaenu". Haya tzarik leparnasa — mebaqqesh be"birkat hashshanim". Abal be"shomea tepilla" yakol lishol kol tzerakayv, mippene shehi kolelet kol habbaqqashot. Ukeshehu mosip — matchil babberaka veachar kak mosip, abal lo yosip veachar kak yatchil habberaka, mippene shetztzarik laasot iqqar mimmatbea shettiqqenu chakamim ubaqqashato tihyeh tepela. Veyesh mi sheomer shekkeshemmosip babberaka meen otah beraka, im mosip umebaqqesh rachamim bishbil kol yisrael — tzarik lomar bilshon rabbim velo bilshon yachid, shello yihyeh kehepseq battepilla. Velo yosip ella besop habberaka velo beemtzaah, shekkesheshshoel tzorke rabbim beemtza habberaka — nireh kemosip al matbea shettiqqenu chakamim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyachid, abal betzibbur — muttarim. Velaken omerim selichot beemtza birkat "selach lanu", veken beemtza beraka emtzait shel yom hakkippurim. Veim shoel tzerakayv mammash, kegon sheyyesh lo choli betok beto, o shehu tzarik leparnasa — yakol lishol apillu beemtza habberaka, vehu sheyyomar bilshon yachid velo bilshon rabbim, shello yidmeh kemosip al matbea shettiqqenu chakamim. Ub"shomea tepilla" yakol lishol ben bilshon yachid ben bilshon rabbim, ben tzerakayv mammash ben tzorke rabbim, shebbirkat "shomea tepilla" kolelet kol hatztzerakim ulekak nitqena. Umikkol maqom keshemmosip letzorek yachid — lo yaarik apillu hu meen habberaka o be"shomea tepilla", abal leachar hattepilla qodem sheaqar raglayv — rashshay lehaarik apillu keseder yom hakkippurim. Umah shennohagin lomar selichot bi"selach lanu" umarbim betachanunim beemtza beraka, zehu mippene shehem tzorke rabbim. Veken apillu letzorek yachid muttar lomar selichot vetachanunim harbeh beemtza beraka im rabbim tzerikim letorato, shezzehu ketzorek rabbim. Vetob lizzaher bekol zeh, ap al pi sheyyesh choleqim al debarayv umattirim kol zeh (vedibrehem nirim iqqar):
Tob lehitvaddot be"shomea tepilla" bilshon yachid, millebad havvidduy shebbilshon rabbim sheachar hattepilla, velishol achar kak mezonotayv apillu hu ashir:
Hambaqqesh rachamim al chabero bepanayv — en tzarik lehazkir shemo, shenneemar: "el na repa na lah", velo hizkir shem miryam. Abal shello bepanayv — tzarik lehazkir shemo:

Ap al pi sheg' rishonot chashubot keachat veken g' acharonot, mikkol maqom y"g emtzaiyyot enan chashubim keachat. Lepikak, im dilleg beraka achat, o shettaa bah taut shemmachazirin oto — en tzarik lachazor lebirkat "atta chonen" ella lerosh habberaka shettaa bah o sheddilleg. Umikkol maqom mishsham veelak tzarik lomar al hasseder, sheim lo nizkar ad leachar kamma berakot — tzarik lachazor velomar kullan achareha, sheim yomar otah beraka lebaddah bammaqom shennizkar — nimtza shinna sidderan shel berakot velo yatza yede chobato, shesseder berakot hu meanshe keneset haggedola umehem kamma nebiim, vesameku sidran al hammiqraot:

Lepikak, sheliach tzibbur sheshshakach lomar "anenu" betaanit tzibbur ben "goel" le"rope" velo nizkar ad leachar shechatam birkat "repaenu" — lo yachazor, sheim haya chozer haya tzarik lomar "anenu" veachar kak "repaenu" shello leshannot sidran shel berakot, vezeh i epshar, sheim ken birkat "repaenu" hi beraka lebattala, kevan sheen machazirin oto bishbil "anenu" kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqs"h. Abal im lo chatam "repaenu" — yomar "anenu" veachar kak "repaenu". Velo ameru sheen machazirin oto ella keshei epshar lo letaqqen tauto ella im ken yachazor vibarek birkot hattepilla shenit, abal lomar birkat "anenu" lebaddah — machazirin oto, shezzeh enah niqra chazara kevan sheomerah bimqomah ben "goel" le"rope". Veim nizkar achar chatimat "repaenu" qodem chatimat "shomea tepilla" — yomar "anenu" be"shomea tepilla" keyachid. Vehu haddin im lo hayu asara hammitannim bebet hakkeneset ubau achar "repaenu" — omer be"shomea tepilla", veyachtom "baruk atta Hashem haoneh beet tzara veshomea tepilla". Veen zo chatima bishtayim, mippene shebbirkat "shomea tepilla" vachatimatah mashmaah ben al tepillat taanit ben al shear hattepilla. Lepikak, im chatam be"shomea tepilla" lebad — yatza. Veim shakach gam be"shomea tepilla" — omerah beraka bipne atzmah achar "bashshalom". Veen zeh shinnuy misseder habberakot, kevan shekkebar nistayyemu birkot y"ch:

Im taa veamar "anenu" qodem "reeh na beaneyenu" — tzarik lachazor velomar "anenu" achar "reeh na", sheim lo yachazor — nimtza sheamar birkat "reeh na" shello bimqomah, shemmeqomah qodem "anenu", veseder habberakot meakkeb:
